title: Price impact
description: How much each unit of flow moves the price, and whether that is rising. Rising impact means the book is getting thinner for its size.

kyle_lambda.label: Price impact
kyle_lambda.description: The slope of price change against signed flow over the current window. Higher means the same trade moves the price more.

lambda_drift.label: Impact change
lambda_drift.description: Price impact now against the previous window. Positive means flow is moving the price more than it did.
